name: Free Image Composer Studio
description: Compose selected free-source images into finished cards, posters, social graphics, heroes and moodboards.
author: Free AI Hub 63
ai_context: When the user asks to create a card, poster, social image, hero or collage from available/free image sources, treat it as a composition task: identify suitable visual subjects, suggest concise overlay copy, choose an appropriate layout/template, preserve source/licence attribution separately, and produce a finished design rather than only listing image links.

quick_actions.label: Create romantic card
quick_actions.prompt: Create a romantic card from free/public image sources. Find suitable warm imagery, compose a polished final design and add the text I provide.

quick_actions.label: Create social graphic
quick_actions.prompt: Create a polished social graphic from available free/public images, with a clear focal image, readable text hierarchy and downloadable final design.
